chunks: (Joseph) answered: "I will give you its interpretation before the food you are served arrives. This knowledge is one of the things my Lord has taught me. I have given up the religion of those who do not believe in God and deny the life to come."

key_terms.تَأْوِيلِهِ: interpretation or meaning of the dream
key_terms.مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِي رَبِّي: that which my Lord has taught me

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Joseph's promise to interpret the dream before the food arrives?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Joseph (AS) demonstrates the concept of *ta'wil* (interpretation of hidden meanings), attributing his divine insight directly to his Lord as proof of his fidelity compared to the polytheists. Shia scholarship often highlights this as a key instance of prophetic knowledge (*'ilm al-*) extending beyond mere prediction to spiritual discernment, reinforcing the validity of leaving the *millah* (religion/concept) of those who deny the Hereafter.
